new_jobs.title: Solution Architect
new_jobs.jd: **About Infosys** Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 56+ countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over four decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. Our always-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem. Visit www.infosys.com to see how Infosys (NYSE: INFY) can help your enterprise navigate your next. **Short Description** We offer an inspiring opportunity to join an engaging team which supports the digital transformation for various industries. Your major task as (Senior) Solution Architect is to provide technical expertise on build the innovative solutions on the cloud and on the premise. In this role, you will also be responsible for collaborating with global teams during analysis, design, development and testing phases. **Responsibilities** * Participate in the communication with customers and internal stakeholders, derive and analyze the requirements related to building new applications, migrate existing solutions, migration methodologies and tools, review and work out solutions and proposals. * Designing extensible, maintainable, and high-performance systems in line with industrial IT strategy. * Work out suggestions for both domestic and global customers in terms of defining functionality and estimation for solutions, as well as the maintenance strategies. * Contribute to technical research for new requirements and feasibility studies of proposed design. * Present and communicate design & implementation to customers and various teams for review * Deliver training and case study to team members. **Qualification** * University degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related field is required * More than 12 years working experience on enterprise application development and system migration between on-premises and cloud environments. * Have experience to design systems to meet industrial requirements to implement business process and specific business logics. * Be familiar with building application in on-premises environments or on top of cloud-native infrastructures, have experience in designing high performance systems and performance optimization. * Be proficient in Java or .NET programming and frameworks, including Spring Cloud, Spring MVC or .NET architecture. * Be familiar with DBMS such as Oracle, SQLserver, mysql, Mongo DB. * Be familiar with one or more major enterprise applications such as SAP, CRM * In-depth knowledge of infrastructural components, including VPC, VM, storage, message bus, API, authentication, and authorization services etc. * Demonstrable experience of working within an agile environment. **Language:** Mandarin, English **EEO Statement** At Infosys, we recognize that everyone has individual requirements. If you are a person with disability, illness, or injury and require adjustments to the recruitment and selection process, please contact our Recruitment team for adjustment either via the following email Infosys\_ta@infosys.com or call 1-866-472-0935. Please note in order to protect the interest of all parties involved in the recruitment process, Infosys does not accept any unsolicited resumes from third-party vendors. new_jobs.title: Senior Architect (OpenShift, AI, Middleware)
new_jobs.jd: The Red Hat Consulting team is looking for a Senior Architect to join us in Taiwan. In this role, you'll use our unique OCP, AI and middleware application capabilities for hybrid cloud, container and AI solution the client needed. You will play a key role in our customers' evolution in enterprise development and in making our solutions practical and workable for their businesses. You will be focused primarily on architectural project support and delivery in pre­sales and post­sales efforts, typically in the conceptual approach, design, and early implementation stages, with a focus on solving complex technical problems, and expand your core base of expertise. As a Senior Architect, you'll work hand­-in-­hand with the account team, customers, and consultants to ensure their architectural visions are communicated and delivered effectively. What you will do * Guide the on-site architecting design and implementation of technologies like Red Hat OpenShift, AI, Virt and APPDev Middleware.. * Gain understanding of customer infrastructures and application and business needs, make recommendations to resolve issues, and help them make strategic decisions * Build enterprise applications and capabilities around cloud technologies to streamline development and enable continuous feature release of applications * Work with both non­technical and technical stakeholders to extract and define system requirements, use cases, and priorities on at least 5 projects * Create an architectural vision for the technical aspects of a project using one or more technologies * Participate in kicking off new projects, inform the implementation team of the project's design, and monitor the progress of a project to ensure it continues to conform to the overall architecture; partner with management and understand how contributions add value at both the project and department level * Collaborate, build relationships, and shape team members to work toward common goals across function groups * Continually develop the customer relationship throughout the sales and delivery life cycle, including knowledge of their business domain, strategic initiatives, technical strategy, and long-term vision * Guide customer value through taking a lead role in coordination across stakeholders and implementation teams * Act as a conduit between clients and Red Hat, including sales, solutions architects, technical account managers (TAM), Customer Experience and Engagement teams, and the Business Units (BU) What you will bring * 12+ years of experience working directly with enterprise stakeholders on a range of development and deployment projects * 6+ years of experience as a leading consultant, system architect or development lead, operating in a senior capacity in the open source community or equivalent experience * Proven implementation of industry standards and practices as they relate to projects and solutions led by the architect (e.g., ITIL, TOGAF, UML, Archimate) * Solid and up-­to­-date understanding of wider trends in IT as they pertain to their area of practice (e.g., Hybrid Cloud, containerization, AI modeling, Virtualization, microservices/AI agent development and Security) * Knowledge of software development methodologies, object-oriented design, development principles including enterprise design patterns, Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS), API management, DevOps, MCP, and AI agent/mobile development are preferred. * Understanding of Java frameworks and libraries, e.g., Spring, Hibernate, Apache Struts, and Apache Tomcat * Understanding Python used for AI is preferred. * Understanding Ansible playbook script used for Automation is preferred. * Advanced Java(or any other developing lang.) and architecture experience, including demonstrated architect-level involvement with many aspects of middleware is preferred. * Advanced experience with at least one of the major middleware solutions, preferably Red Hat JBoss Middleware or competitive solutions like Oracle WebLogic, IBM WebSphere, webMethods, and TIBCO is preferred. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluent language skills in English are a plus **About Red Hat** Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact. **Inclusion at Red Hat** Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village. **Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)** Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee. Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application-assistance@redhat.com. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

new_jobs.title: Partner IT Manager
new_jobs.jd: Join our diverse and inclusive Supply Chain team and be a part of one of the top Supply Chains in the world! You'll have the incredible opportunity to join us at CBM-IT (Component Business Management – IT) and play a key role in helping Cisco's semiconductor and system suppliers adopt Cisco's B2B integration, data traceability and cybersecurity standards, and in giving Cisco trustworthy partner data, an honest performance picture and a clear view of whether each partner is ready to go live. As a valued member of our team, you will work closely with Cisco internal IT teams and the IT teams of our external manufacturing partners, fostering an inclusive and respectful atmosphere. Much of this work is assembled by hand today; you will use AI and automation tools to take the manual effort out of it. This is not a software development or delivery role. You will not write code or deliver applications. Your job is to work with Cisco internal IT teams and partner IT teams to drive partner adoption and outcomes. **Your Specific Responsibilities Will Include** * Serve as the primary CBM-IT operational contact for an assigned portfolio of manufacturing partner sites, working alongside the Partner Manager who owns the overall relationship. * Run the full partner adoption lifecycle: integration design review, pre-UAT readiness, UAT ownership, cutover and hypercare, and stabilization. * Translate Cisco's B2B message requirements into specifications a partner can build against, then verify what they built against what was specified. * Run structured test and UAT cycles with partner IT teams: build test cases, execute them, log defects and drive them to closure. Track readiness gate criteria across active integration programs and flag gaps early enough that something can be done about them. * Monitor partner B2B transaction flows for completeness, duplication and timeliness, surfacing anomalies before they become escalations. * Investigate transaction-level discrepancies to root cause with Cisco internal IT teams and partner IT teams: missing manufacturing events, duplicate messages, and inventory positions that do not reconcile between Cisco and partner systems. * Drive partner IT issues to documented closure, including formal 8D corrective actions, closing on verified evidence and not on declared status. Identify failure patterns that appear across several partners but originate in a single shared component, so they are fixed once rather than repeatedly. * Coordinate with Cisco internal IT teams and partner IT teams so that issues, changes and readiness gates are clear to everyone involved. * Operate the quarterly Partner IT Scorecard for your assigned partners: collect evidence, apply the published rubric, prepare draft scores for review, and ensure every published number reconciles to source evidence. As part of this, assess each partner's AI and automation maturity and encourage adoption. * Own the automation agenda for your portfolio: identify manual data exchanges and checks that can be automated, and move partners from flat-file to structured, machine-readable integration. Your success is measured in part by how much of this work stops being done by hand. * Use AI assistants and AI agents, alongside existing automation tools, to handle repeatable work such as test case generation, UAT evidence capture, specification conformance checking, anomaly detection and cross-source reconciliation, so each successive partner comes online faster than the last and no data integrity check is performed manually twice. * Act as the business-side owner for AI agent use cases in your area: define the use cases and requirements for the engineering teams that build the agents, and validate that agent output is correct before it is relied on. **Who You'll Work With** As a member of the Cisco IT team, you will be a valuable part of the CBM-IT (Component Business Management – IT) team. Our team is dedicated to delivering exceptional services, tools, platforms, and data that are essential for powering one of the top Supply Chains in the world. At Cisco, we prioritize innovation and evolution to provide our Supply Chain team with a competitive advantage. This includes optimizing and automating business process systems and applying AI and automation tools to day-to-day operational work. You will collaborate with Cisco internal IT teams, Partner Managers, Architects, Analysts and global delivery teams within the Organization, across various functions in Cisco, and with the IT teams of our external manufacturing partners. You'll have the opportunity to join a dynamic, empowered, and collaborative team that values diverse perspectives and inclusive practices, all focused on driving partner adoption, integration readiness and measurable outcomes with our strategic suppliers. We believe that embracing diversity and fostering an inclusive environment are key to driving innovation and achieving success. Our team is committed to ensuring that everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to contribute their unique ideas and experiences. The CBM-IT (Component Business Management – IT) team works at the intersection of supply chain execution and IT transformation, ensuring Cisco's semiconductor and system suppliers adopt B2B integration, data traceability, and cybersecurity standards. We are building a Taiwan-based Partner Management team to engage closely with strategic suppliers such as TSMC, ASE, and Fabrinet. This team serves as Cisco's local presence to strengthen executive relationships, accelerate execution, and enable long-term supplier alignment. Location: Taipei / New Taipei, Taiwan. Reports to: Partner Adoption Lead, Taiwan, CBM-IT. Coverage: assigned to one partner pod, with a defined cross-pod remit. Travel: approximately 10–15%, to partner sites in Taiwan and Southeast Asia. Career path: This role is the entry point into Cisco's partner management discipline and opens two routes to Grade 10: a partner-facing track toward Partner Manager with full relationship ownership, or a specialist track toward Partner Integration Architect. You will receive mentorship, progressively larger partner portfolios, cross-pod exposure across Cisco's full partner base, and direct exposure to partner IT leadership. Within 2–3 years, successful candidates are expected to be ready to step up into one of these roles. **Who You Are** As an experienced partner-facing IT and data professional, you have a deep interest in how technology and data move between companies. You excel at working with external IT teams to get integrations tested, verified and stable, and at checking what is actually true rather than what is reported. Your self-motivation and resourcefulness enable you to tackle complex challenges and drive practical solutions. You thrive in collaborative settings, working effectively with stakeholders to deliver growth and value across projects. Your adaptability allows you to navigate ambiguity with ease, making you an asset in dynamic and evolving situations. You have a demonstrated ability to influence and inspire both within your team and across the organization, contributing to strategic initiatives and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. You can tell the difference between reported status and verified status, and you are willing to say so. You are interested in building a career in partner management or partner integration architecture. **Minimum Requirements** * Bachelor's degree with 3+ years of related experience. * Experience in supply chain IT, manufacturing systems, ERP/MES operations, B2B/EDI integration, supply chain analytics, or IT operations. * Demonstrated ability to run a structured test or UAT cycle independently: build test cases, execute, log defects, drive to closure. * Working SQL: able to profile, reconcile and validate transaction-level data independently, rather than relying on reported status. * Practical experience automating operational work, with a conc

new_jobs.title: Software Product Planning Senior Professional
new_jobs.location: New Taipei City, New Taipei City, Taiwan
new_jobs.jd: **About HTC** HTC is a global technology company advancing innovation across AI, virtual and augmented reality, and connected digital experiences. We bring together technology, creativity, and product innovation to develop experiences that connect people and expand what's possible. **About Your Next Opportunity** HTC is seeking a **Software Product Planning Senior Professional** to help shape the strategy, development, and growth of our software and AI-powered products, including VIVE Roundtable. This role is ideal for an experienced software product management professional who understands how to turn customer needs, market opportunities, and emerging technologies into successful software products. In this senior-level individual contributor role, you will lead product planning and execution across the product lifecycle, from discovery and roadmap development through feature prioritization, launch, and continuous improvement. You will work closely with engineering, UX/UI design, AI development, marketing, and business teams to deliver intuitive, competitive, and scalable software experiences. The ideal candidate has recent, hands-on experience managing software products, preferably SaaS or AI-powered applications, and can balance customer needs, technical feasibility, business objectives, and product performance. **Job Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To** * Lead software product strategy and roadmaps: Define product vision, strategy, and roadmaps aligned with business goals, customer needs, and market opportunities. * Manage end-to-end product development: Drive the product lifecycle from discovery and requirements gathering through development, testing, launch, and ongoing optimization. * Translate customer needs into product requirements: Gather user feedback, identify pain points, define use cases, and develop product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. * Drive AI and SaaS product development: Support the evolution of AI-powered software experiences, including VIVE Roundtable, with a focus on usability, engagement, reliability, and differentiated customer value. * Prioritize features and enhancements: Work with engineering and design teams to evaluate feasibility, balance competing priorities, and deliver high-impact features within agreed timelines. * Analyze markets and competitors: Research software industry trends, competing products, customer expectations, and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for differentiation and growth. * Drive product launches and go-to-market planning: Partner with marketing, sales, and business development teams to develop positioning, launch plans, product messaging, and adoption strategies. * Support SaaS business models: Evaluate subscription models, pricing strategies, packaging, user acquisition, retention, and monetization opportunities where applicable. * Monitor product performance: Establish and track KPIs such as active users, engagement, conversion, retention, customer satisfaction, and revenue performance to guide product decisions. * Collaborate across functions and regions: Coordinate stakeholders across engineering, design, AI development, marketing, and regional business teams to ensure alignment and timely execution. * Present product recommendations: Communicate roadmaps, business cases, product performance, risks, and recommendations to management and senior leadership. * Drive continuous improvement: Use analytics, customer feedback, and product experiments to refine features, improve user experience, and support long-term product growth. **Basic Qualifications (Required Skills And Abilities)** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, Information Systems, or a related field. * Recent, hands-on experience in software product management is required, with a proven track record of managing software products from planning through launch and ongoing improvement. * 8+ years of experience in product management, software product planning, or product strategy within the software or technology industry. * Experience managing software applications, digital platforms, or SaaS products, including product roadmaps, feature prioritization, requirements, and release planning. * Demonstrated ability to translate customer insights and business objectives into clear product requirements and actionable development plans. * Experience working closely with software engineering and UX/UI design teams in an agile development environment. * Strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret product metrics, user behavior, market research, and competitive intelligence. * Understanding of software development lifecycles, product releases, quality assurance, and post-launch optimization. * Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams. **Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills And Abilities)** * Experience managing AI-powered products, generative AI applications, or AI-enabled digital platforms. * Experience with SaaS products, cloud-based software, subscription services, or recurring-revenue business models. * Familiarity with AI product capabilities and limitations, including large language models (LLMs), conversational AI, AI agents, and multi-model or multi-agent experiences. * Experience with user analytics, experimentation, A/B new_jobs.title: New Business Opportunity Scouting Manager
new_jobs.jd: **Role Purpose** The New Business Opportunity Scouting Manager is responsible for originating and shaping new growth ideas for Corning by scouting emerging technologies, unmet customer needs, and adjacent market spaces. This role sits at the front end of the innovation funnel: generating a steady flow of well-framed, evidence-backed opportunities. The ideal candidate combines technical fluency with strong market curiosity, is energized by open-ended discovery, and can translate weak signals from technology and customer landscapes into concrete, actionable business concepts. Success in this role depends on collaborations with internal technology communities and external expert networks, and on the judgment to separate interesting technology from investable opportunity. **Job Selling Points** * Opportunity to directly shape the company’s future growth agenda * High visibility with senior business and corporate leadership * Broad exposure across innovation, strategy, M&A, commercialization, and partnership development * Ability to work on both organic and inorganic growth opportunities * Platform to influence emerging businesses beyond the core * Strong development opportunity toward broader business, strategy, or general management leadership roles **Key Responsibilities** Ideas Origination (primary focus) * Generate and continuously refresh a pipeline of new business opportunity ideas, framing each with a clear articulation of the customer "job to be done," the underlying technology enabler, and the potential fit with Corning capabilities or outside investment options. * Conduct in-depth market and technology research to surface unmet and unarticulated customer needs, including white-space and adjacency analysis. * Develop and pressure-test opportunity hypotheses, using primary interviews, expert calls, and secondary research to validate or kill ideas quickly. * Engage deeply with technology and industry experts, startups, universities, and VC/ecosystem contacts to stay ahead of market and technology trends and identify emerging opportunities early. * Design and lead ideation sessions with internal stakeholders, bringing external insight and provocations that inspire new product and business concepts. * Package ideas into clear, compelling opportunity briefs and business cases for senior management review and prioritization. Technology Scouting and Assessment * Continuously monitor and analyze technology advancements, with a focus on breakthroughs that could disrupt, impact, or enhance Corning's product offerings. * Assess emerging technologies for maturity, differentiation, defensibility, and commercial potential. * Demonstrate agility in adapting to new technological paradigms and incorporate this knowledge into opportunity generation and strategic planning. * Actively network within industries of interest to build relationships that lead to business development opportunities. * Represent Corning in industry forums, conferences, and professional networks to enhance the company's profile, expand scouting reach, and advance strategic interests. Customer Engagement and Insight * Engage customers on technical and select commercial topics to understand their needs, roadmaps, and pain points, and to source new opportunity ideas directly from the market. * Translate customer insight into validated need statements and early product-market fit hypotheses. * Facilitate discussions between customers and internal technology and product teams to test concepts and sharpen direction. Technical Insight Sharing * Serve as a technical and market-insight resource to senior management, providing recommendations on technology-driven opportunities and risks. * Share scouting findings across internal technology communities and cross-functional teams, fostering a culture of curiosity, external awareness, and continuous learning. * Build and maintain internal networks across R&D and business units to ensure technological insights inform early-stage concept development. Opportunity Development and Handoff * Own ideas through early validation and concept definition, then transition qualified opportunities to product development, business development, or program teams with clear documentation and rationale. * Provide ongoing subject-matter and market-insight support to receiving teams as needed, without carrying primary program management accountability. * Maintain a transparent opportunity pipeline and reporting cadence, tracking idea status, validation progress, and conversion outcomes. **Experiences/Education - Required** * Bachelor's degree; MBA/PhD is a plus * Technical background, especially in electronics, new materials, semiconductor, telecommunications, or green energy is preferred * Strong academic record * Fluent in English and Mandarin * 5+ years of work experience, with 2+ years of investment-related experience, preferably in consulting, investment banking, corporate/business development, venture capital, or technology scouting * Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including the ability to structure ambiguous problems and reach defensible conclusions with incomplete data * Demonstrated ability to conduct primary research and expert interviews to build market insight * Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal * Highly motivated and intelligent with the ability to work effectively in a team environment * Highly proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word * Strong work ethic and ability to manage multiple concurrent research streams * Willing to travel depending on needs (domestic 20–30%, international 5%) * New business ideation and opportunity framing * Growth strategy development * Commercialization strategy * Inorganic growth / M&A support * Due diligence and target assessment * Deal sourcing and external opportunity mapping * Business case development * Market research and megatrend analysis * Strategic and financial assessment * Executive communication and storytelling * Cross-functional leadership * Innovation screening and portfolio prioritization * Ability to bridge technical innovation and commercial opportunity * Stakeholder management across global and regional teams **Experiences/Education - Desired** * Experience in display, semiconductor, electronics materials, optical materials, ceramics, packaging, or adjacent advanced technology sectors * Experience with venture investment, startup evaluation, or minority investment activities * Experience supporting integration planning following transactions * Experience creating sourcing channels, partnership models, or investment mechanisms * Prior strategy consulting experience strongly preferred * Experience supporting both organic and inorganic growth initiatives * Experience in Asia commercial strategy and global intelligence / market insight work **Soft Skills** * Enthusiastic, personable, positive attitude, and high integrity * Intellectually curious with a bias toward exploration; comfortable operating in ambiguity and with open-ended problems * Indefatigable/persistent, pro-active, self-motivated with the ability to work under limited supervision * Passionate about building relationships and networking at a professional and personal level * Strong oral and written communication skills along with good listening skills * Attention to detail and organized * Ability to learn quickly and to grasp financial/business terminology and concepts
